structural_change: s81_a2f_field4: field16 whole-body congestion split into four independent field4 clock/placement leaves. Input pipeline partitions by bit; selector/drain state replicated; full53/4quarters/3slots unchanged. Zero added cycles. Native in0.6/out0.57T budgets, HB1 input/no firm output hold. | r2 (S-VM 2210): r1 s81_a2f_field4_pilot_2118_r1-split4-COMMIT-4ea8603cc routed TT +52.89 / FF -1.23 / DRC 0; all reg D pins FF >= +14.14, ONLY output ports fail (o_v[27,31,26,4,28], fault[2,3]; -1.23..-0.02 ps), QN->INV->BUFx2 straight from the pin registers because r1 had outhold false; hold ECO missed (-1.22). Fix = recipe pin hold pad HB1xp67 on every output (outhold true), as on the inputs: zero cycles, same RTL/pins/outline/root. | r3 (S-VM 0030): r2 (a9fb3a31a) routed TT +44.67 / FF -10.52 / DRC 0; KEEPWIRES hold ECO least-bad FF -10.26 (rc 9). Every reg D pin FF >= +14.36; the only hold fails are outputs: 128 o_data (-10.52) and o_v (-0.28). Their launch flops sit on an early clock leaf (o_data[106] CLK 127.55 ps vs IO reference L_min 140.5), so clk->pin QN+INV+BUFx4f+HB1+BUFx2 = 205.0 ps < 215.5 required. Control4 r3 showed HB1->HB2 buys ~13 ps (too thin here), so r3 = HB3 output pad (out_cell), inputs keep HB1; TT output setup slack 77.7 ps carries it; zero cycles, same RTL/pins/outline/root. | r3c: same as r3 plus clock entry moved from the SW corner to the W-face centre (ck swapped with i_sel[331]); the r2 early leaf under o_data sat on the corner-fed branch (CLK 127.6 vs reference 140.5).
